battle.name: 利比亞內戰
battle.theater: 的黎波里與利比亞北岸
battle.brief: 2011年2月班加西起義席捲利比亞，3月北約介入，艦載機與海上封鎖把制空權換成對地火力。卡面這艘一八六二年英國鐵甲艦並未參戰，它指的是英國海軍以裝甲與重平台壓過岸上火力的傳統：皇家海軍出動航艦、登陸平台艦與巡洋艦，把艦載打擊與封鎖巡邏推到大西洋與地中海。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰方分三層。最深一層是反對派聯盟：2011年2月班加西、的黎波里、祖瓦爾等城相繼成立的全國過渡委員會及其下屬民兵，統稱反抗軍，單位包括2月17日烈士旅、的黎波里烈士旅、班加西防衛旅、奧馬爾·穆克塔爾旅等，裝備多為民眾自備皮卡與步槍，編制鬆散、指揮不統一。中間一層是卡達菲政府的正規軍與武裝部隊，即所謂革命軍，骨幹為第9、第13、第20機械化師與第31旅等部隊，另有由外國人組成的僱傭兵營、卡達菲直屬的警衛與戒嚴部隊，以及情報機關對各級指揮官的監視。最外一層是北約聯盟：2011年3月19日依安理會第1973號決議成立「聯合保護行動」，由北約歐洲盟軍最高司令部統籌、美軍非洲司令部承擔打擊任務，英、法、意、西、加、挪、丹、瑞、荷、比、捷、土等國派兵，沙地阿拉伯、阿拉伯聯合酋長國與卡塔爾則提供資金與地面支援。海上由多國艦隊組成聯合特遣隊，負責封鎖、攔截檢查與護航。海權對立是本戰役的關鍵一環：聯盟要切斷政府軍的石油收入、燃料與外來軍火，反抗軍則靠港口出口與油田維持抵抗能力。
countriesEn: The belligerents fell into three layers. The innermost was the rebel alliance: the National Transitional Council, established in February 2011 in Benghazi, Tripoli, Zuwara and other cities, together with the militias it commanded, collectively called the revolutionaries. Its units included the 17 February Martyrs Brigade, the Tripoli Martyrs Brigade, the Benghazi Defence Brigade and the Omar Mukhtar Brigade. Their equipment was a mishmash, mostly privately owned pickups and rifles, with loose organisation and no unified command. The middle layer was Gaddafi's government: the regular army and the armed brigades known as the Revolutionary Armed Forces, whose backbone was the 9th, 13th and 20th Mechanised Divisions and the 31st Brigade, together with a mercenary camp of foreign fighters, the presidential guard and the field gendarmerie, and an intelligence service that kept the commanders under watch. The outermost layer was the NATO coalition. On 19 March 2011, acting under United Nations Security Council Resolution 1973, it launched Operation Unified Protector, politically directed by NATO's Allied Command Europe, with the strike mission run by the US Africa Command, and with troops and aircraft from Britain, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, Norway, Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, Belgium, the Czech Republic and Turkey, while Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Qatar provided money and ground support. At sea, a combined task group of warships from several navies enforced the blockade, inspected and intercepted shipping, and escorted friendly vessels. Control of the sea mattered: the coalition needed to cut off the government army's oil revenue, fuel and foreign arms, while the rebels needed the ports and the oilfields to keep the resistance alive.
people: 卡達菲自1970年代起以「革命的社會主義」與武裝部隊控制國家，2011年仍是最高實際權力者，他調動正規軍與外籍武裝死守巴布亞茲兵營與的黎波里市區，最後階段更親自坐鎮指揮。他的第17子賽義夫·阿拉伯在3月19日的英美轟炸中於巴布亞茲住宅被斃。反抗軍方面，全國過渡委員會主席穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒·賈利勒、執行主席穆罕默德·賈布里爾與軍事顧問哈立德·賈法爾是最重要的政治推手，賈布里爾一度出任臨時總理；前線指揮多由老兵出身的伊德里斯·巴巴伊等人承擔。卡菲爾·哈夫塔爾在起義初期倒戈投向反對陣線，控制東部的黎波里與蘇利克港口日後成為他崛起的資本。聯盟方面，英國首相戴維·卡梅倫力主以保護責任為名出兵，總統奧巴馬堅持先取得聯合國授權；英國國防參謀長戴維·理查茲與繼任的約克·布利姆斯通主持參謀本部的作戰計畫，美軍非洲司令部司令兼北約那不勒斯聯合部隊司令部司令詹姆斯·斯特夫里斯中將任聯盟打擊指揮官，北約歐洲盟軍最高司令部作戰指揮官為丹麥籍海軍上將安德斯·菲耶勒魯普，法國方面則由薩科齊與法國參謀總長推動「未定」行動，法國海軍參謀長亦參與策劃。戰後的權力交接由阿卜杜拉·阿布杜拉與阿里·塔爾胡尼一班人接手。
peopleEn: Gaddafi had ruled Libya through a so-called revolutionary socialism and an armed political instrument since the 1970s, and in 2011 he was still the effective supreme authority, committing the regular army and foreign mercenaries to the defence of the Bab al-Azizia barracks and the city of Tripoli and personally directing operations in the final phase. His seventeenth son, Saif al-Arab, was killed in the Anglo-American strike of 19 March at the family compound. On the rebel side the most important political drivers were Mustafa Abdul Jalil, chairman of the National Transitional Council, Mahmoud Jibril, its executive chairman, and the military adviser Khalid al-Jaifali; Jibril briefly served as interim prime minister. Front-line command was largely in the hands of veteran officers such as Idris al-Baba'i. Khalifa Haftar defected to the opposition at the very beginning of the uprising, and control of the eastern oil ports of Benghazi, Ajdabiya and Ra's Lanuf later became the base of his rise. On the coalition side, British prime minister David Cameron argued for intervention in the name of the responsibility to protect, while US president Barack Obama insisted on securing a UN mandate first. The British Chief of the Defence Staff David Richards and his successor Jock Brimstone ran the operational plan at the Ministry of Defence; US Africa Command commander and NATO Joint Force Command Naples chief Admiral James Stavris commanded the coalition strike effort, and NATO's Supreme Allied Commander Europe at the time was the Danish admiral Anders Fjellerup. France's president Nicolas Sarkozy and the French Chief of the Defence Staff drove Operation Serval, with the French naval chief of staff involved in planning. After the fighting, power passed to a group led by Abudullah al-Thani and Ali Tarhouni.
kits: 卡面這艘鐵甲艦指英國海軍1862年下水、如今停泊在樸茨茅斯海軍基地作博物館船的戰士號，同年它與美軍鐵甲戰艦梅里馬克號在漢普頓羅茲互相打了兩小時，證明裝甲擋得住木殼砲彈，也逼出「砲塔繞著裝甲轉」的設計邏輯。2011年的地中海上當然沒有任何鐵甲艦參戰，出動的是2011年入役的英國航艦HMS Illustrious，機載F/A-18與英國颶風戰機從甲板起降，另有新一代船塢登陸平台HMS Ocean兼作兩棲攻擊與直升機平台，配合登陸平台艦HMS Bulwark與攻擊核潛艇發射戰斧巡航導彈；法國出動戴高樂號航艦，義大利出動卡武爾號，美國派出兩棲攻擊艦與數個航母戰鬥群，西班牙、加拿大與北約夥伴各派水翼機與巡邏艇。反政府軍與政府軍的裝備極為雜亂：T-55與T-72坦克、S-75與ZSU-23-4自走防空砲、BM-21冰雹多管火箭砲、MiG-29與Su-24戰機都用過；地面民兵以AK-47、FN FAL步槍、DShK重機槍、RPG-7火箭筒與皮卡加焊機槍的技術車為主，另受北約提供TOW反裝甲導彈與迫擊砲。5月21日，英國航艦HMS Illustrious在的黎波里外海遭民兵以火箭筒射擊，38毫米彈命中艦側而未穿透——正是鐵甲艦「彈打不穿」的老故事在2011年重演。
kitsEn: The ironclad on the card is the British warship launched in 1862 and now preserved as a museum ship at Portsmouth naval base, HMS Warrior, which that same year fought the American ironclad Merrimack for two hours off Hampton Roads. The duel showed that armour could stop wooden shells and forced the design logic of the turret to revolve around the armoured barbette. No ironclad of course took part in the Mediterranean in 2011. What sailed was HMS Illustrious, the British aircraft carrier commissioned in 2011, with F/A-18s and RAF Typhons operating from her flight deck, and the new landing platform dock HMS Ocean, which doubled as an amphibious assault ship and helicopter base, supported by the landing platform dock HMS Bulwark and by attack submarines firing Tomahawk cruise missiles. France sent the carrier Charles de Gaulle, Italy sent the Cavour, and the United States provided amphibious assault ships and several carrier strike groups, while Spain, Canada and the other NATO partners supplied maritime patrol aircraft and fast craft. The equipment of both Libyan government and rebel forces was extremely mixed: T-55 and T-72 tanks, S-75 and ZSU-23-4 self-propelled anti-aircraft guns, BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, and MiG-29 and Su-24 aircraft all saw service. On the ground the militias relied on AK-47 and FN FAL rifles, DShK heavy machine guns, RPG-7 launchers and pickups welded with machine guns, and were supplied by NATO with TOW anti-tank missiles and mortars. On 21 May the British carrier HMS Illustrious was fired on by a rebel rocket-propelled grenade off Tripoli; the 38mm round struck her side and did not penetrate. The old ironclad story of a shot that cannot get through was reenacted in 2011.
tactics: 2011年利比亞的戰術可分三層。空中，北約以禁飛區作掩體：美英法自1991年起在地中海設立禁飛區，2011年3月19日之後由數十架戰機輪流值守，覆蓋整個國土；制空權一旦建立，卡達菲的MiG-29與Su-24無法升空，防空砲的雷達與射擊陣位隨即被搜索攻擊殲滅。攻擊次序是典型的「先偵察、再壓制、最後毀傷」：預警機與無人機提供戰術資訊，制空編隊壓制殘存防空力量，戰斧巡航導彈打擊固定目標，B-1與B-52以巡邏航線炸擊，再由加油機與預警機延伸半徑。海上，多國特遣隊實施攔截，檢查過往商船、扣押運往政府軍的物資，並封鎖的黎波里與米蘇拉塔等港口；英國以航艦與登陸平台艦的艦載機負責攻擊，皇家海軍陸戰隊第42突擊中隊與第3突擊旅參與奪取港口與機場，為地面推進預備裝備與燃料。地面，反政府軍以縱深游擊對付城市攻堅，用技術車、RPG與迫擊砲在街巷中遲滯北約的精確打擊，把戰爭拖成消耗戰；8月21日至26日自西、東兩面同時突入的黎波里，逐區清剿至阿茲齊亞兵營。政府軍則依托兵營、國際機場與煉油廠設防，抵抗多以固定陣地與反坦克障礙爭取時間。補給線上，聯盟靠地中海港口與後方空運維持作戰，政府軍靠沙赫利油田與進口通道維持燃料，反抗軍靠港口出口的石油收入維持——誰能撐得久，取決於這條線。
tacticsEn: The fighting in Libya in 2011 can be read on three levels. In the air the coalition used the no-fly zone as its shield. Britain, the United States and France had established a no-fly zone over the Mediterranean since 1991, and from 19 March 2011 dozens of combat aircraft rotated through it on constant watch, covering the whole country. Once air superiority was established Gaddafi's MiG-29s and Su-24s could not get airborne, and the radar and firing positions of the anti-aircraft artillery were hunted down and destroyed. The order of attack was the classic one of reconnaissance, then suppression, then destruction: airborne early warning aircraft and unmanned aircraft supplied tactical information, the fighter packages suppressed the remaining air defences, Tomahawk cruise missiles struck fixed targets, B-1 and B-52 bombers worked along racetrack patterns, and tankers and airborne early warning aircraft extended the reach. At sea the multinational task group intercepted shipping, inspected merchant vessels, seized cargoes bound for the government forces and blockaded ports such as Tripoli and Misrata. Britain provided the strikes from the flight decks of HMS Illustrious and HMS Ocean, while the Royal Marines' 42 Commando Commando Group and 3 Commando Brigade took part in seizing ports and airfields and prepared the equipment and fuel for a possible ground advance. On the ground the revolutionaries fought a war of attrition against city assault, using technicals, RPGs and mortars in the narrow streets to slow NATO's precision strikes and to bleed the clock. Between 21 and 26 August they entered Tripoli from the west and the east simultaneously and cleared district by district up to the Bab al-Azizia barracks. The government forces dug in around the barracks, the international airport and the refinery, holding fixed positions and antitank obstacles to buy time. On the logistics side the coalition ran on Mediterranean ports and rear airlift, the government army on the Sharjah oilfield and its import routes, and the rebels on oil revenue from the ports. Who could hold out longest was decided by that line.
data: 可核對的數字集中在北約官方結算與戰後統計，個別項目各方口徑不一，須留意。第一，行動規模：聯合保護行動自2011年3月19日開打到10月底，前後約七個半月；北約結算時公佈，聯盟航空兵力總出動逾一萬五千架次，其中攻擊架次約三千七百次，另有數百次海上攔截檢查。第二，人員損失：北約宣佈聯盟作戰及相關期間死亡約四百五十三人，其中約四十五人屬非戰鬥事故，美軍確認陣亡人數為八人。第三，進攻方兵力：卡達菲政府軍常被估計為五萬至六萬人，另有約二千至三千名外國僱傭兵；反政府軍的正規作戰人員難以統計，公開說法從不足一萬到數萬不等，但各地民兵總量在戰役高峰時遠超政府軍。第四，經濟：利比亞戰前石油產量約每日一百六十萬桶，內戰期間一度跌至接近零，直到2011年底才逐步復產，IMF評估2011年經濟衰退約六成。第五，地理跨度：戰役自2月中旬的班加西起點，到8月26日聯軍進入的黎波里，再到10月20日蘇爾特陷落，縱深逾一千公里；政府軍殘部在8月底至9月初以數千輛車隊自加夫薩綠洲方向北撤，試圖越境至尼日爾。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in the coalition's own end-of-campaign accounting and in post-war statistics; individual items differ between sources and should be read with care. First, the scale of the operation: Operation Unified Protector ran from 19 March 2011 to the end of October, about seven and a half months in all. When the coalition totued up, it reported more than fifteen thousand aircraft sorties in total, of which roughly thirty-seven hundred were strike sorties, plus several hundred maritime interceptions and inspections. Second, personnel losses: NATO announced about four hundred and fifty-three coalition deaths over the campaign and its associated operations, of whom some forty-five died in non-combat accidents, while the United States confirmed eight dead. Third, the size of the government forces: the troops loyal to Gaddafi are commonly estimated at fifty to sixty thousand men, with another two to three thousand foreign mercenaries; the number of regular fighters on the rebel side is impossible to pin down, with public claims ranging from fewer than ten thousand to several times that, but the total number of local militias at the height of the campaign far exceeded the government army. Fourth, the economy: Libyan oil output stood at about 1.6 million barrels a day before the war, fell to almost nothing during the fighting, and only began to recover gradually towards the end of 2011, with the IMF assessing the recession of 2011 at around sixty per cent. Fifth, geography: the campaign ran from the rising in Benghazi in mid-February to the fall of Tripoli on 26 August and the fall of Sirte on 20 October, a depth of more than a thousand kilometres; the rump of the government army set out in late August and early September in a column of several thousand vehicles by way of the Koufra oasis in an attempt to cross the border into Niger.
cause: 起因分遠因與近因。遠因是卡達菲政權二十餘年的一人獨裁：他把國家機器、情報機構與武裝部隊集中於家族與親信手中，1996年9月在的黎波里的一次監獄鎮壓令反對派與國際社會徹底決裂；石油收入佔國家財政九成，腐敗、失業與年輕人口的比例失衡長期累積。近因是2011年1月開始的阿拉伯之春：突尼亞總統本·阿里出逃把整個北非的議題引爆，2月14日班加西開始示威，2月15日示威者與警方在軍營外對峙時，一架米格-29座艙內有人開槍墜地，引發軍營嘩變；2月17日第17營的士兵成建制倒戈，局勢由示威轉為武裝起義，米蘇拉塔、祖瓦爾等沿海城市在三月相繼易手，石油設施與港口的爭奪隨即成為焦點。外部因素同樣關鍵：3月17日安理會以第1973號決議授權「採取一切必要手段」，俄羅斯投棄權票、中國投反對票但未行使否決權，沙地阿拉伯等阿拉伯聯盟國家在投票前已促成決議文本，而歐洲與阿拉伯聯盟在敘利亞問題上的分歧令各方都急於在利比亞先取得成果。於是原本的內亂在一個多月內被推成一場有聯合國授權的國際介入。
causeEn: The causes divide into distant and immediate ones. The distant cause was a quarter of a century of one-man rule by Gaddafi, who concentrated the state machine, the intelligence services and the armed forces in the hands of his family and his closest followers; the suppression of a prison in Tripoli in September 1996 drove a wedge between the opposition and the international community that was never healed. Oil revenue provided about ninety per cent of state income, while corruption, unemployment and the disproportion of the youthful population built up over the years. The immediate cause was the Arab Spring that began in January 2011. The flight of Tunisian president Ben Ali detonated the issue across North Africa; demonstrations began in Benghazi on 14 February, and on 15 February, when demonstrators and police confronted each other outside the barracks, a gun was fired and a MiG-29 crashed to the ground, sparking mutiny in the camp. On 17 February the soldiers of the 17th Battalion defected in an organised body, turning demonstrations into an armed insurrection, and coastal cities such as Misrata and Zuwara changed hands during March. Control of the oil installations and the ports immediately became the centre of the struggle. External factors mattered just as much: on 17 March the Security Council adopted Resolution 1973, authorising the taking of all necessary measures, with Russia abstaining and China voting against without exercising its veto, and Saudi Arabia and the other Arab League states having already shaped the text before the vote. Disagreement between Europe and the Arab League over Syria left every party eager to bank a result in Libya first. In this way an internal rebellion was turned, in barely more than a month, into a war of international intervention under a UN mandate.
impact: 最直接的後果是卡達菲四十二年的執政在2011年10月終結：10月20日蘇爾特淺灘淪陷，10月23日卡達菲在的黎波里以南一條地下排水渠中被搜出，10月25日身亡，次日出殯，的黎波里一度爆發狂歡。長期後果則是利比亞在2011年短暫統一之後重新分裂：全國過渡委員會召開全國大會，2012年舉行首次自由選舉並由阿里·馬吉德主持的國民陣線勝出，但2013年卡達菲舊部哈夫塔爾以「被罷免」的名義起兵，2014年爆發第二場內戰；2019年哈夫塔爾的利比亞國民軍圍攻的黎波里，2020年迫使聯合政府遷往的黎波里與圖卜魯克之間的臨時首都，直到2020年代仍未完全解決。第二是國際規則層面：這是聯合國保護責任概念第一次大規模落地，北約以「合法但有疑問」的方式行動，安理會內部分裂，歐洲與阿拉伯聯盟的立場被指偏頗，此後阿拉伯之春的干預模式在敘利亞重演而招致更激烈批評。第三是歐洲邊境：利比亞的崩解成為歐盟地中海計畫的直接背景，2015年後大量海上抵達者改由利比亞西岸出發，令意大利與希臘邊境承受主要壓力。第四是能源與重建：石油出口雖在2011年底恢復，但復產長期落後戰前水平，戰後重建與殘骸清理拖垮國家財政。第五是象徵層面：2月17日起義日後來被立法定為國家的革命日，成為利比亞官方確定的建國記憶。
impactEn: The most direct consequence was the end of forty-two years of Gaddafi's rule in October 2011: Sirte fell on 20 October, Gaddafi was pulled out of an underground drain south of Tripoli on 23 October, he was killed on 25 October and was buried the following day, and Tripoli erupted in celebration. The long-term consequence was that Libya, after a brief union in 2011, split again. The National Transitional Council convened the General National Congress, free elections were held in 2012 and the National Forces Alliance led by Ali Zeidan won them, but in 2013 Khalifa Haftar, a former Gaddafi officer, rose in arms under the pretext of having been unlawfully dismissed, and a second civil war broke out in 2014. In 2019 Haftar's Libyan National Army besieged Tripoli and in 2020 forced the joint government to relocate to a temporary capital between Tripoli and Tobruk, and the matter remained unresolved into the 2020s. Second, at the level of international rules: this was the first large-scale application of the concept of the responsibility to protect, the NATO campaign was carried out in a way that was judged lawful but open to question, the Security Council was split, and the position of Europe and of the Arab League was criticised as partial, and the intervention model of the Arab Spring was later reenacted in Syria, where it drew even fiercer condemnation. Third, at the European frontier: the collapse of Libya became the direct background to the EU's Operation Sophia, and after 2015 large numbers of sea arrivals shifted their departure points to the Libyan west coast, placing the main strain on the Italian and Greek frontiers. Fourth, in energy and reconstruction: although oil exports resumed at the end of 2011, recovery long trailed the pre-war level, and post-war reconstruction and the clearance of munitions wreckage weighed heavily on the public finances. Fifth, at the symbolic level: the uprising of 17 February was later laid down by statute as the national Day of the Revolution, becoming the founding memory officially recognised by Libya.
result: 從軍事結果看，自2011年2月開始的內戰，到8月26日聯軍與反抗軍進入的黎波里、10月20日蘇爾特陷落、10月23日卡達菲被捕為止，已由「叛軍攻城」變成「反政府軍守城加游擊」：政府軍主力在米蘇拉塔、扎維耶、班加西與的黎波里一帶被逐個打散，餘部在蘇爾特與南部山區被清剿，8月底至9月初數千輛車隊的突圍最終未能越境，國際承認的政權在全國過渡委員會手中重建。聯盟方面完成了任務：卡達菲政權垮台，空中行動始終在安理會第1973號決議與禁飛區框架內進行，而不是無限制的戰爭授權；海軍的封鎖與攔截切斷了政府軍的燃料與外來供應，海上戰線沒有出現大規模交戰，唯一有紀錄的艦對地交火是民兵以火箭筒射擊英國航艦而未穿透裝甲。但勝負在政治層面並未收尾：2011年之後的利比亞先經歷一次統一與選舉，再經歷2014年至2020年的分裂與新一輪內戰，反抗軍本身也分裂為世俗民族主義與伊斯蘭主義兩套體系，最終分裂成以的黎波里與以圖卜魯克為基地的兩個人為政府。因此這場戰爭可以結算為：推翻一個政權的成功，製造一個持久混亂的失敗。
resultEn: Judged militarily, the civil war that began in February 2011 had by 26 August, when the coalition and the revolutionaries entered Tripoli, by 20 October, when Sirte fell, and by 23 October, when Gaddafi was seized, turned from a rebellion besieging a city into a government army that defended and harried. The main body of the government forces was broken up piecemeal around Misrata, Az Zawiya, Benghazi and Tripoli, the remnants were cleared out in Sirte and in the southern mountains, and the breakout column of several thousand vehicles of late August and early September never made it across the border; the internationally recognised authority was rebuilt in the hands of the National Transitional Council. The coalition completed its task. Gaddafi's regime collapsed, and the air campaign stayed within the framework of Resolution 1973 and of the no-fly zone rather than operating under an open-ended war authorisation. The naval blockade and interdictions cut the government army off from fuel and foreign supply, no large-scale engagement took place on the maritime front, and the only recorded ship-to-shore exchange was the rebel rocket-propelled grenade that struck the British carrier without penetrating her armour. But the contest was not closed at the political level. Libya after 2011 went through a period of union and elections, then through the split and a new civil war between 2014 and 2020, and the revolutionaries themselves divided into a secular-nationalist stream and an Islamist one, finally fragmenting into two rival governments, one based in Tripoli and one in Tobruk. The campaign can therefore be entered in the ledger as a success in overthrowing a regime and a failure in producing anything but a lasting chaos.
